potoru.description: Namespace: version, get(id), getCompiler(id), mountPotoruPlayer, mountPotoruCompiler, compile, loadPlayer.

mountPotoruPlayer.description: Mount a Potoru player into a host element (loads the player code on demand); resolves to the instance.

mountPotoruCompiler.description: Mount the authoring widget into a host element (loads the compiler code on demand).

compile.description: Compile a source folder ({ files }) or an authoring-API script ({ script }, experimental) to .poto bytes with diagnostics.

PotoruPlayer.description: TSX wrapper: server-rendered placeholder the runtime mounts a <potoru-player> into.

PotoruCompiler.description: TSX wrapper: server-rendered placeholder for the authoring widget (files, editor, diagnostics, preview).
